item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders about perspective, projecting, and mind reading, so the work is already clear. Your mind will tell stories about what others think and what the past means. Treat those stories as guesses, not facts. When you catch one, ask whether this moment supports the life you're building. Your action: at midday, pause for one minute and rewrite one negative thought into a neutral, factual one.
